Each rank makes the hold 8% shorter: you're in and out of a pocket faster.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.deep_pockets.d: Each rank takes 15% more of what a mark carries, and gives you another try at a pocket that turns up empty.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.soft_step.desc: Each rank lets you sneak closer to onlookers before they see what you're up to.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.quick_hands.de: Reach in from the side, not only from behind, and marks must turn further round before they see you.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.lockpicking.de: Each rank widens a lock's sweet spots by 15% and puts 20% less strain on your pick. From rank 2 your pick feels the binding pin or the gate; at rank 3 the first slip of every try is forgiven.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.ghost.desc: Guards take no longer to rob than anyone else, and a theft nobody saw is never missed.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.shadowed.desc: Monsters see you 10% less far per rank in the dark, in proportion to how dark it is where you stand. A torch in your hand shows zombies 20% less far per rank.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.quiet_step.des: Sneaking hides you from monsters better: they see you half as far (rank 2: two fifths) instead of three fifths. The noise you make sneaking carries a third as far (rank 2: a fifth) instead of half.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.slip_the_net.d: Monsters that lose sight of you give up the chase twice as fast, and the blood you spill stops drawing zombies twice as soon.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.sneak_attack.d: A blow on a monster that hasn't noticed you (from behind, or while it searches) does 2.5 times the damage instead of double (rank 2: triple).
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.assassinate.de: A full-strength hidden blade stab on a monster that hasn't noticed you does ten times the damage, like one on a crippled foe. Without this it is only a sneak attack.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.climber.desc: A stronger grip. Anyone can jump at a tall wall holding forward to cling and climb it (not ice, glass or leaves) for 3 s before slipping (hold forward to climb, strafe to shimmy, sneak to let go). Rank 1: your grip lasts 6 s. Rank 2: 8 s, and you climb faster on walls and poles. Rank 3: your grip never gives out, and you climb faster still.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.freerunner.des: Sprint and jump at anything waist-high (up to a block and a half: a fence, a wall, a block) to vault it without losing speed. Rank 2: wall kick. In the air beside or facing a wall, jump to kick off it, once per wall until you land. Everyone breaks into a fast run after 2 s of sprinting; Freerunner makes it faster (rank 1: +40% instead of +30%) and rank 2 gets you there in 1.25 s. Rank 1 also lets you flip in mid-air: tap sneak once (forward, back or a strafe key picks the flip).
From any height, a landing in a hay bale, water or leaves takes no fall damage. Fall looking down and you dive head first.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.bar_swing.desc: Jump at a fence, iron bar or chain lying above your head to catch it and hang, swinging. Jump to let go and fly forward with the swing; sneak to drop.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.wall_runner.de: Sprint and jump alongside a wall to run along it for 1.5 s (rank 2: 2.5 s), barely falling. Then drop, or jump to kick off it (with Freerunner rank 2). Wall Runner also lets you sprint at a wall and jump to run up it: 3 blocks (rank 2: 4), without it only in a fast run (2.5 blocks). At the top you grab the ledge or cling to the wall.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.forager.desc: Each rank gives an 8% chance of an extra harvest from ripe crops and nether wart. You also know butchering: you can judge a butcher's skill from their cuts.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.second_wind.de: Under 30% health you start to heal (Regeneration, longer each rank), at most every 20 seconds.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.weathered.desc: Each rank: you burn 20% shorter, and powder snow freezes you a quarter slower.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.iron_stomach.d: Rotten flesh, raw chicken and the like never give you Hunger, and dirty water from anywhere (a river, a swamp, a puddle) never turns your stomach.
Falls hurt 30% less (but they always hurt). Powers that cancel fall damage work as before.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.last_stand.des: Once a day, a blow that would kill you leaves you on half a heart instead.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.meditation.des: Stand still, sneak and look down for a few seconds to sit, and with this perk the sitting is meditation: it earns mastery toward your power's next move. Each rank after the first makes it quicker. Z Fighters and Gravity users also shadowbox with the Shadowbox key (I), and that's how they train in a Gravity user's Immense Field.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.weapon_forms.d: Learn every weapon's full combo: twirls, spins, flips and every attack of its string. Until then each weapon has only one or two plain swings. Opens the Combat Arts.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.make_do.desc: Out here, anything's ammo. Hold any item in your off hand and load it into a crossbow: snowballs freeze, slime balls bounce, TNT flies lit, a fishing rod becomes a grappling hook.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.heavy_blows.de: Each rank adds 4% to your melee damage.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.brace.desc: Each rank: you're knocked back 10% less.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.bulldozer.desc: Each rank: your blows knock foes back further.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.packhorse.desc: Sprinting, mining and fighting tire you a quarter less: hunger drains slower.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.titans_grip.de: A full-strength blow has a 1 in 5 chance to stagger what it hits (slowed and weakened for 2 seconds).
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.momentum.desc: Blows landed within 2 seconds of each other make a combo. Each rank: every hit in the combo makes the next 4% heavier (up to 5 hits).
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.cleave.desc: Each rank: a full-strength blow carries 20% of its damage into up to 3 foes beside what you hit.
Finisher for axes, maces, two-handed and blunt weapons: every 4th hit of a combo, if it's full strength, cracks the ground. Foes round the target take half the blow and are thrown into the air.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.executioner.de: Weapon finishers: sneak + hold left-click on a downed foe with a weapon to finish them with that weapon's move (sword, axe, mace, spear, bow and more). Without it, a weapon or tool only has the basic finish: a blade stabs through, anything else slams. Bare hands snap the neck (hold at the head).
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.rend.desc: Finisher for swords, knives and spears: every 4th hit of a combo, if it's full strength, makes the target bleed for 5 seconds.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.charge.desc: Press the Combat Art key (mouse side button 1) to shoulder-charge forward. The first foe you hit takes 1.5x your attack damage, is shoved back and staggered. 12 second wait.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.war_cry.desc: Sneak and press the Combat Art key (or just the key, if you don't know Charge) to roar. Foes within 10 blocks are weakened and slowed for 6 seconds; you and nearby players get Strength for 8. 45 second wait.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.shield_throw.d: With a shield in hand, press the Combat Art key to hurl it. It strikes the first thing in its way, ricochets on to the next foe (or off a wall) and flies back to you. If a wall stops it on the way back, it drops there; relic shields always find their way home. Each rank: one more ricochet. Press it again to call it back early. 5 second wait.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.bladestorm.des: Every 8th hit of a combo, if it's full strength, you whirl round and strike every foe around you for the full blow.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.steady_hands.d: Each rank: every treatment (bandage, splint, stitch, searing, cleaning, salts, leeches, poppy) and every revive of a downed one takes 15% less time.
Each rank: the bandages and rags you tie heal 35% more.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.bonesetter.des: A splint you put on mends a heart and a half into the broken limb at once. Your stitches and searings hurt half as much.
The Nightfall plague goes easier on you: you catch it for half as long and never worse than its first stage, and its pricks and weakness take you only half as often. Only your leeches draw the bad blood out: the plague and poison leave whoever you put them on.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.lifesaver.desc: Anyone you bring round from being downed (a revive or smelling salts) gets up with half their health and their bleeding stopped. Your smelling salts always wake a player who has passed out.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.self_revive.de: Once a day, when you're downed (and awake), hold use with food in hand to eat it and get back up on your own. Steady Hands makes the eating quicker, Lifesaver gets you up on half health.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.dread_presence: Weaker foes and players within 6 blocks (2 more per rank) tremble: slowed and weakened, and a weaker mob's knees sometimes give way. Your groupmates are spared.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.grounded.desc: 10% less harm per rank from spells and powers: magic, a caster's bolts, a power's blasts. Weapons hurt as ever.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.stare_down.des: Sneak and hold your gaze on a weaker foe within 10 blocks for 2 seconds: it often drops its weapon, and it runs. Crew go over the side, riders are thrown, casters lose their spell, outlaws kneel. Stare longer at a ship's captain or a ruler: if your Will beats their nerve, the captain jumps ship, and a weak, poor ruler in their hall gives up the crown (a richer one pays you to go). Stare at another player and they are warned, then the two of you clash wills: press jump to hold your ground.
Downed foes within 8 blocks of you shiver and can't get back up, by time or by anyone's hands but yours. Downed players are never held.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.spellbreaker.d: A full-strength hit on a caster breaks their spell: a necromancer, shaman, blood witch or wizard can't cast for 5 seconds; a player's power stops and their power keys and spells are silenced for 3.
When you down or kill a foe, its own kind within 12 blocks lose heart: slowed and weakened for 8 seconds, and the weaker of them may run.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.snap_the_threa: A full-strength blow on a risen thrall can cut it loose, and it falls to dust (35%). Hit a necromancer and every thrall of his reels.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.shrug_it_off.d: Sneak and jump to throw off every ill effect on you: slowness, weakness, poison, a hex, the plague's mark. 3 minute wait.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.name_that_carr: While you're known as a Warrior (Strength your best pillar), weaker foes within 24 blocks won't start a fight with you. Cornered within 4 blocks, or once you've struck them, they fight.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.witch_hunter.d: 15% more harm per rank to anyone who cast at you in the last 10 seconds.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.will_over_fles: Above half health, another player's power moves you 30% less per rank: gravity, wind, webs, throws.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.grim_hand.desc: Each rank gives a full-strength blow a 7% chance to be a grim crit (half again as hard), and makes every cut 40% likelier to take off a head or a limb. A grim crit's cut, twice that.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.unflinching.de: Each rank lets a held action take one more hit before it's broken off: getting yourself up while downed, bringing someone round, and Second Wind's eating to rise (2 hits without it).
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.no_mercy.desc: Weaker mobs you fell die outright instead of going down. Sneak, or hit with your fists or a club, to down them as ever.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.last_look.desc: Take a head, and every weaker foe within 16 blocks who saw it runs for 5 seconds.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.refuse_to_fall: Once a day, the blow that would put you down leaves you standing on one heart, taking 80% less harm for 5 seconds.
At three hearts or fewer, Will grows: its reaches half again as far, Stare Down quicker, Grounded 10% more, Grim Hand's crits 5% likelier.
Down to one heart, you roar: every foe and rival player within 12 blocks is stunned for 4 seconds, and weaker mobs are knocked flat for 6. Once a full day.
Turn left on a full execution hold to question a downed villager, goblin, orc or player instead of killing them (turn right to kill). Your own edge: no lie gets past you, you can stare them down once your threats fail, and you can make them swear never to raise a hand to you.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.rough_question: Turn left on a full execution hold to question a downed villager, goblin, orc or player instead of killing them (turn right to kill). Your own edge: your threats hurt, break them twice as often, and you get one more try.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.quiet_word.des: Turn left on a full execution hold to question a downed villager, goblin, orc or player instead of killing them (turn right to kill). Your own edge: sneak up behind someone who hasn't noticed you and hold the execution to question them in a choke hold, without downing them first. They never see who held them. You can also ask who else is about.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.devotion.desc: Your patron's favour slips more slowly: a point less a day for each rank.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.ambusher.desc: A sneak attack staggers its mark: slowed hard and weakened for 3 s, so it can't turn and fight back at full strength.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.cutthroat.desc: A kill within a second of a sneak attack or an assassination drops you out of sight: invisible and quick for 4 s.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.iron_hide.desc: Weather and blows have toughened your skin: +2 armour and +1 armour toughness, worn or bare.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.beast_of_burde: Built to haul and to last: a heart more health, and hunger drains a fifth slower.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.tracker.desc: Whatever you wound bleeds for 30 s, leaving a trail of its own blood you can follow to it.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.light_pack.des: You travel light: sneaking and sprinting cost 40% less hunger.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.power_shot.des: Bow: a fully drawn shot that hits much harder and knocks the mark back.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.entangling_roo: Bow: roots burst from the ground where your arrow lands and hold everything there in place.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.barrage.desc: Bow: loose a quick volley of arrows at one mark.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.spirit_wolf.de: Bow: call a ghostly wolf that runs down your mark and fights beside you for a while.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.magic_arrow.de: Bow: a glowing arrow that pierces everything in a line.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.rain_of_arrows: Bow: arrows fall from the sky across an area for a few seconds.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.arcane_missile: Staff or wand: a stream of seeking arcane bolts.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.arcane_explosi: Staff or wand: a burst of arcane force all round you that throws foes back.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.arcane_beam.de: Staff or wand: a channelled beam that burns along its whole length.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.arcane_barrage: Staff or wand: a fan of arcane bolts that spread through a crowd.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.arcane_blink.d: Staff or wand: step through the air a short way, out of reach.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.arcane_evocati: Staff or wand: draw in arcane power, then let it all go at once.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.fire_breath.de: Staff or wand: breathe a cone of flame that sets foes alight.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.fire_slash.des: Staff or wand: a sweeping arc of fire in front of you.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.fire_meteor.de: Staff or wand: call down a meteor on the spot you look at.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.fire_storm.des: Staff or wand: fire rains on an area round you.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.fire_wall.desc: Staff or wand: raise a wall of flame that burns anything passing through.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.fire_hydra.des: Staff or wand: summon a hydra of flame that spits fire at your foes.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.frost_nova.des: Staff or wand: a ring of frost that freezes everything near you in place.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.frost_spikes.d: Staff or wand: spikes of ice break from the ground in a line.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.frost_shield.d: Staff or wand: wrap yourself in ice that soaks up blows for a while.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.frost_lance.de: Staff or wand: a heavy lance of ice that pierces and slows.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.frost_blizzard: Staff or wand: a storm of ice over an area that chills and wears down everything in it.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.frost_elementa: Staff or wand: summon a frost elemental to fight for you.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.enchanted_stor: Sneak-use an enchanting table holding storage. Rank 1: a chest becomes a Bag of Holding. Rank 2: a leather bag becomes iron. Rank 3: an iron bag becomes gold. Costs levels and lapis; a bag keeps what it holds.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.slice_and_dice: Dagger or sickle: a fast flurry of cuts that quickens the next.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.shock_powder.d: Dagger or sickle: throw a powder that stuns everything near you.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.mutilate.desc: Dagger or sickle: a brutal double strike, much harder from behind.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.bear_trap.desc: Set a trap that clamps and holds the first foe to step in it.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.shadow_step.de: Dagger or sickle: step through the shadows to behind your mark.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.vanish.desc: Dagger or sickle: drop from sight for a few seconds; foes lose you.
Knife form: mark the foe you look at; its outline shows to you, even through walls.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.tangle_cord.de: Knife form: throw a pair of bolas from your pack that wraps the first foe's legs.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.cast_off_cloak: Knife form: leave a straw figure where you stood; hostile mobs after you swing at it instead.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.throw.desc: Double axe or glaive: hurl your weapon at a foe; it comes back.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.shout.desc: A war shout that cows the foes near you and steadies your side.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.throw_net.desc: Throw a weighted net that pins a foe where it stands.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.warrior_charge: Double axe or glaive: rush your mark and knock it off its feet.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.warrior_last_s: For a short while nothing can bring you under one heart.
Double axe or glaive: a crushing blow that wounds deep and cuts the healing it can take.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.sheath_draw.de: Blade form: a fast dash that cuts everything it passes on the draw.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.crescent_sweep: Blade form: a low, wide arc in front that knocks foes off their feet.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.rain_of_cuts.d: Blade masterstroke: a storm of cuts on a fallen foe.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.ground_stomp.d: Fist form: a hop, and a small shockwave ring when you come down.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.falling_fist.d: Fist form: while falling, drive down onto the first foe below you.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.rending_claw.d: Claw form: a rake across the front; every foe in the arc is cut and left bleeding.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.feral_pounce.d: Claw form: leap onto the foe ahead.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.spear_lunge.de: Spear form: a long lunge that runs the first foe through and carries on.
Spear form, mounted only: couch the lance and ride your foes down.
Spear masterstroke: throw the spear at a fallen foe and pin it where it lies.
